# SW2URDF 2026-09-08 RC2 / 候选版

## 简体中文

### 相比 RC1 的变化

- MJCF 驱动参数在生成网格前检查，不再等到导出末尾才报告缺失参数。
- 仿真设置中标记需要补齐的刚度、阻尼；不完整设置可在确认后保存为草稿。
- 同时选择多个输出目标时，可明确选择跳过 MJCF，继续导出其他目标；只选 MJCF 时返回补齐参数。
- 不自动猜测增益，不复制 OpenUSD 的参数，也不会擅自改变关节控制方式。
- 隔离并行 UI 测试之间的 WinForms 布局干扰，保留全部截图和文本边界检查，没有通过改大窗口掩盖问题。

### 验证与安装

- Core **129 项**、官方 MuJoCo **9 项**、插件 **997 项**通过，无失败或跳过。
- 已在远端安装；**249 个安装文件**校验及插件注册正常。用户手动验证后反馈：**暂未发现新问题**。
- 此反馈不代表所有 SolidWorks 版本、DPI、模型和长时间仿真均已覆盖；本轮未重复记录 RC1 的四目标导出性能数据。
- 这是 **Pre-release**，不替换稳定版。请备份装配体、关闭全部 SolidWorks 进程，以管理员身份安装 x64 包，再重启 SolidWorks。安装包未做 Authenticode 签名。

[中文手册](https://osrbot.github.io/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/) · [验证记录](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/blob/master/docs/reviews/2026-09-08-mjcf-preflight.md)

## English

### Changes since RC1

- Check MJCF drive parameters before generating meshes instead of reporting missing gains at the end of export.
- Mark required stiffness/damping fields in Simulation Settings. Incomplete settings can be saved as a draft after confirmation.
- For multiple selected targets, explicitly skip MJCF and continue with the others, or return to edit. MJCF-only export requires correcting the settings first.
- Do not invent gains, copy OpenUSD gains, or silently change joint control modes.
- Isolate WinForms layout tests from concurrent UI tests while retaining all screenshot and text-boundary assertions; no window-size workaround is included.

### Verification and installation

- **129 Core**, **9 official MuJoCo**, and **997 plug-in** tests passed, with no failures or skips.
- Installed remotely; **249 payload files** and add-in registration verified. The user completed manual testing and reported **no new issues found so far**.
- This is not blanket coverage of all SolidWorks versions, DPI settings, models, or long simulations. RC1's four-target performance measurements were not repeated for this candidate.
- **Pre-release only**, not the stable Latest release. Back up assemblies, close every SolidWorks process, install the x64 package as administrator, and restart SolidWorks. The installer is not Authenticode-signed.

[English handbook](https://osrbot.github.io/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/en/) · [verification record](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/blob/master/docs/reviews/2026-09-08-mjcf-preflight.md)
